integrity.reproducibility: Complete Python standard-library verifier; two exhaustive face predicates and two full acyclic matching tests, plus rational character calculation.

scientific_limitations: Single graph, not an infinite-family theorem.
The homology representation is determined over the rational numbers, not as an integral lattice.
Equivalent unindexed literature is a residual risk.
title: Six six-spheres and an orientation-twisted tetrahedral edge representation in a total cut complex
